caveats: Public credit-metered execution, not per-second CPU/RAM product. One credit covers 60s at 1 CPU+1 GiB; larger matched CPU/RAM sizes scale credits linearly (2 CPU/2 GiB is 2 credits/minute). Separate CPU×RAM multiplication would be wrong.
Not fully priceable in ENGINE_CARD: unknown USD resource rates or machine shape. Null is not zero; do not rank as a free provider.

Features set to null were not verified. No sandbox was purchased or tested; feature/performance statements are documentation claims. Null maximums are unknown unless a cited note explicitly states unlimited.
A complete monthly bill requires known snapshot/egress/plan limits; do not silently treat missing ancillary charges as free.
Streaming/async output requires Pro. Free: 5 concurrent, 1 custom OCI image, 10 API keys. Concurrency limit returns HTTP 429. One execution per thread_id at a time (409).
Thread state retention is configurable (24 h, 7 d, 30 d, forever default) and counts toward the 10 GB free storage then $0.10/GB-month.

fleet.verification: Free developer documentation explicitly says no credit card. Paid-plan payment/identity checks not detailed.
fleet.tiers: Free 5 concurrent runs; Pro 100; Enterprise advertises unlimited (sales).
fleet.notes: Concurrency counts executions, not retained machines. 10/50 runs fit Pro; 300/1,000 require Enterprise discussion. Separate vCPU/GPU account quotas and turnaround unknown.
